text:
elena_pm: ok team — syncing thread for long-term platform roadmap: need a prioritized plan for routing policies, multi-region tenancy isolation, and concrete launch criteria for Q4+. Main asks from sales/CS: predictable latency for FinRegCo, VPC/on-prem path for HealthSys, and a cheaper dedicated tier for scaleups.

sam_eng: +1. can we split into 3 tracks? 1) policy DSL + guardrails 2) region/affinity launch lanes 3) onboarding & cutover playbooks.

elena_pm: yes. proposed prioritization: policy DSL first (blocks automated rollouts), region lanes second, onboarding third. rationale: DSL prevents unsafe rollouts that create noisy neighbor incidents.

ibrahim_infra: note: DSL work will touch router + control plane. estimate 6w for MVP (authz + simple precedence rules) if we reuse existing routing templates. risks: migration ordering and telemetry gaps.

nora_ml: for model-aware routing, we need metadata at request-time (model family, quantization tier). also call out fallback variants — e.g., fallback to smaller quantized model on capacity pressure. that affects launch criteria.

aisha_sre: launch criteria proposals:
- SLOs: p99 tail latency ≤ 350ms (hosted) for tier-1 customers, p50 ≤ 80ms
- Regression gate: no more than 1% increase in error rate during canary
- Obs: token-level cost breakdown visible in console
- Rollback: automatic fallback to last-good model variant within 30s on error spike

elena_pm: customer asks to surface these in the sales-facing doc. action: can someone draft a 1-pager with gate checklist and migration windows?

sam_eng: I can draft tech checklist. questions: how strict is the data residency requirement vs latency? FinRegCo wants EU-only routing, same SLA as global. that implies dedicated capacity in eu-west region or strong affinity.

ibrahim_infra: we can do region affinity + hard residency by routing policy + tenant placement, but dedicated capacity commitments needed. capacity planning: for FinRegCo we need reserve GPUs for peak 95th percentile. that'll be a contract/ops ask.

nora_ml: also call out quality budget. if we enable aggressive quantization for cost, product must accept a 1-2 pt accuracy delta on sensitive evals. include per-tenant eval baselines as part of onboarding.

aisha_sre: migration playbook (high-level):
1) Canary in sandbox region for 48h with production traffic replay
2) Canary with 1% real traffic + automatic rollback monitors
3) Gradual ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with heat checks and ops signoffs
4) Post-cutover: 7d monitoring window before SLA conversion

elena_pm: good. priorities for next sprint (2w):
- DSL proto + routing precedence matrix (sam)
- Canary playbook + ops runbook draft (aisha + ibrahim)
- Onboarding checklist template (nora)
please add owners to doc by EOD.

sam_eng: noted. will create RFC and link to this thread.

ibrahim_infra: ops-bot: remind #product in 3d to confirm owners (ops-bot)

ops-bot: Reminder queued: post reminder in #product in 3 days. :robot_face:

elena_pm: final note — include pricing implications for Dedicated vs Hosted fallback. sales needs clear T-shirt sizes (S/M/L) for reserved capacity. we'll loop in pricing next week. :spiral_calendar: 

sam_eng: sounds good. tagging @sales in the RFC when ready.

elena_pm: thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow at 10 for alignment. :thumbsup:
